batting.name: WP Saha
batting.dismissal: c SE Marsh b P Awana

batting.name: MEK Hussey
batting.dismissal: st Gurkeerat Singh b PP Chawla

batting.name: JA Morkel
batting.dismissal: c DA Miller b P Awana

batting.name: Mandeep Singh
batting.dismissal: c SK Raina b MM Sharma

batting.name: DJ Hussey
batting.dismissal: c DJ Bravo b R Ashwin

batting.name: Gurkeerat Singh
batting.dismissal: c MEK Hussey b DJ Bravo

balls.text: pushed down to long-on for a single to end the innings on 187!
hundred for Raina! single tapped to the off side and that's his first in IPL cricket, who is understandably chuffed about it, he's punched the air and is then actually applauding the audience!

appeal for a run-out against Raina! it was driven through the point and the third-man has to come around to field it, well done in the field, good throw back and bails whipped off but Raina was diving in yet again and this time he's quite in, he moves on to 99 here!
whoa, smoothly hit, it was fuller on the off stump and caresses it over the bowler's head, barely hit and it goes on to take Raina three short of his 100
full-toss outside the off stump, opens the face of the bat and drives it through, the fielder gets a hand there and restricts it to 2
outside the off, very full and he shoulders arms, thought it was quite wide but the umpire does not think so
full and driven through the covers for a four, the field on the off side was up inside the circle and it's drilled, gets his front foot out and gets four very valuable runs
and a shorter one again but very slow, Raina was looking to move towards the off stump now and picks it up over to deep square-leg for a single
was moving to the leg stump and the bowler sends it down on his pads, short of length too, pulled away to the deep square-leg region for a couple of runs
short of length and down the leg side, he lets it go and it's a wide

top-edge and this is caught! short of length delivery from the bowler and he was looking to pull it from outside the off but only manages to get a top edge on that one, flies away to Miller at long-on who takes an easy catch there
edged for a four, difficult to set fields for that but it was full and taken as a full-toss by the batsman, gets an edge and it's run away for a four
short of length and on the leg stump line, the fine-leg's down at the boundary too and the pull stroke's gone to him for a single
fuller outside the off stump and he opens the face of the bat to carve it away to deep point for a single to retain the strike, he's looking at a 100 here
fuller outside the off and driven down the ground for a single
full-toss and Raina sees an opportunity for going over mid-off who is inside the circle, Hussey at mid-off runs to his right and dives full length to prevent the four, only a single there!
slower bouncer and Raina seems to have read that late, wants to cut it hard but misses, I think beaten by the bounce
worked it away to the gap between deep square-leg and deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs
and what a shot again, that's six! that did not look hit too hard and tell you what it's still gone over the long-on field for a six, timed it and it's gone

and now Morkel joins in the fun, not any fun for the bowler but the Super Kings are on fire here, that was fuller outside the off and Morkel swings it over the long-off field for a biggie, easily over!
whips it to mid-wicket now for a single to get to the other end
and now he sweeps it away for a four! right in the slot, slower again and Raina was having none of it, smashed away to the fence for a one-bounce boundary
slows it down well, but look at that shot from Raina, he moves towards the leg stump, gently opens the face of the bat and plays it through backward point, bisects two fielders there
opens the face of the bat and drives it through the covers for a couple of runs
slower one, shorter too, and easily picked away to the leg-side for a single

and yet again, six more! he's attempting those fuller ones but they are not quite full for a very well-settled Suresh Raina who has played it with a very straight bat over the bowler's head, six more!
full-toss on the off stump and wants to hit it over, slices it away to long-off for a single
this time he gives himself room and tries to drive it through, gets it only to extra cover and they are off for a quick single, Hussey tries to run him out at the non-striker's end but misses
shot, now that's a classy one! it was full alright and Raina was expecting it this time, was a slower one too and extends his arms, smashes it over the bowler's head for a six!
outside the off stump, fuller in length yet again and he's only able to dig it away to the off side for a single
outside the off stump and it was fuller too, pleasant change in length from the bowler, he was looking to go over the top but does not connect well, on the bounce to long-on
on his pads and it's tucked away to the leg side for a single to bring up Raina's half-century, he's in good form these days
shorter from Chawla and cuts hard but to the deep point fielder for only a single
driven down the ground to long-on for a single this tiem
dropped, sitter! that was swept away and it went high in the air and then goes down straight to the fielder who misjudges it and has to dive forward, floored!
hit on the up through the covers for a single and gets of strike
looks to sweep it away and it seems to have come off a top edge and runs down to third-man for a four! beat the keeper and the outfield it quick. Really quick!
back to that line again, cramping the batsman for room, wants to flick it away there but does not get any bat on it
cut away hard and to the fence, he was bowling well till that point, not affording too much room there and he cuts it hard through the point region for a four
full outside the off stump, wants to drive it through the covers but does not hit it off the middle and it goes away to the off side
keeps it up to the bat on the off stump and its driven down the ground to long-off for a single
fuller on the middle stump and driven down the ground, hit crisply too but well fielded by the long-n fielder who rushes across to get to the ball
short of length and on the leg stump, he was looking to flick it away to the leg side, hits his pad and theres a bit of an appeal from the bowler, runs away to the off side
smashed away through covers for a single this time
fullish length and driven back to the bowler
fuller on the off stump and driven down to the long-off for a single
bad ball, down the leg side and Raina gives it his all, slog sweeps it fine and over the short fine-leg for a four, one-bounce
slower one and pushed it to the leg side, they take a single and do not come back for the second this time

gone, is it run-out? third ump called for here and Dhoni could be in trouble! yes he is, they were very quick between the wickets for the first one, and equally quick for the second but the fielder, n fact it was the bowler himself who ran to his right like it was a 100 m dash followed by a slide at the end and he throws it to the keeper, all in one motion, and Dhoni isn't quick enough, just, just short!
seam up from Chawla, lot of them this over and this is slightly shorter too, tapped to the off side
slows it down this time and that's delicately pushed to the leg side, they take the first and then run back for a quickly taken second
quicker on the middle, tapped back to the bowler
gone for a six this time, again that delivery right in his slot, again that swing of the bat and again that six over mid-wicket!
fuller and he defends it to the off side, off the front foot and single to the covers

gone, stumped? he was coming down the track and Chawla saw that, bowled it at a medium-pace, Hussey was a tad surprised there and does not get any bat on it, sneaks through to the keeper who does well to gather it first and then whip off the bails, what a delivery, what a stumping!
fuller outside the off and slower as well and drives it down to long-off for a single
outside the off stump, tipped over to the leg side for a single
on a good length and it was coming back into the batsman, runs it through to the third-man for a single
short of length yet again from Gony and Hussey isn't sparing any of these deliveries, pulled away over backward square-leg for a four
short of length but cramps him for room, what does Hussey do? just taps it close inside the circle and rushes back for the second
short of length first up, not the best of pitches to bowl that length as Hussey shows it, swivels around and pulls hard, to the fence for a four

swing of the arm and for a six, Hussey has had a good spell but ends on a poor note, it was very full and in the slot for Raina, goes through with the shot and it flies over the long-on area for a six!
and now he slows it down, taps it to long-on for a single
quicker on his pads and flicked well but to the fielder at fine-leg, rushes quickly to him
yorker length but slower, he was looking to come down and spank it, but needed to bring his bat down quickly, digs it out
driven down to long-on for a single this time
driven through the covers for four this time! it as fuller and hit well but should have been stopped by Marsh inside the circle, sneaks through to the fence
reverse sweep but does not get it to the fence, it's well hit but luckily for the bowler it rushes towards the short third-man fielder
swept away again in that gap on the leg side that I was talking about earlier, fielder needs to run across to get to it
on his pads, not quite full enough, quicker it was and it rolls over to the leg side for a single
full-toss on his pads and flicked away to the deep square-leg region for a single
outside the off and he takes it from there and sweeps it in the gap between deep mid-wicket and backward square-leg, a couple results
fuller outside the off and wants to drive it, was in the air and it falls short of the bowler
wants to rush down and smash it through the covers, to the extra-cover fielder, again, not for runs
driven through the covers for a single now
down the leg side and he was looking to paddle it away, could have gotten it to the fence, does not get a bat though
slower from Hussey this time and on his pads, tips it over to the leg side for a single
slammed to the off side but straight to the extra-cover fielder
fuller and driven down to long-on for a single
short of length and tapped to the leg side very close to the keeper, he runs across to field it and they are quickly away for a single, had he fielded it cleanly, could have been a runout chance
and immediately he shortens the length, pushed to the leg side for a single
placement, that's all placement, slightly flighted outside the off and he opens the face of the bat and drives it over the top through wide long-off for a four
this time it's slightly wider outside the off but continues bowling full, no chance of turn and driven down to long-off
fuller on his pads and tapped away to the leg side for a single
full-toss yet again and on the off, Raina wanted to drive it down the ground, gets it back to the bowler
full-toss from over the wicket and pushed down to mid-wicket for a single
punched hard but straight to mid-off and on one bounce, this time Raina does not attempt the single
and again, uses his feet, goes down and wants to spank it away, no timing and it runs towards wide mid-on for a single
short of length and he wants to pull it away by going down the pitch, it's quite short and hits Hussey's top-edge, it flies to square-leg where there's no fielder and they come back for a couple
goes for the pull this time and hits it straight to short mid-wicket, straight to him
wants to drive it away again and misses, the ball's not quite coming on as well as it was in the last game here, not yet anyway
short of length and he wants to pull it away, gets too low, hits it low on his pads I think, rushes away for a single
another good one, fuller, flatter, quicker and tapped back to the bowler, much better from David than the last over he bowled last game
fuller on the off and driven to extra-cover

fuller on the leg stump, driven to mid-on and they are off for a quick single, Chawla fields and throws the stumps down at the non-striker's end, the third-ump has been called. The bat is in the air but when the bails are dislodged, his glove seems to be inside the crease, lot of replays seen and given not-out. There was one replay, front on, which suggested it could have just have been out, but the other one, the square one gives Raina the benefit.
poor ball, very wide and a full-toss, had he left it alone, would have been a wide, but he decides to go for it, drives it in the gap too and gets a four!
full, almost yorker, digs it back to the bowler
outside the off and fuller, he gets his bat and pad out and defends it back
bit of swing back into the batsman, defended on the front foot, to the off side

gone, caught at deep square-leg, Saha's gone! it was on his pads and he wanted to flick it away over the leg side, gets a good portion of the bat, but unfortunately not into the gap, straight into the hands of the fielder, Marsh takes a simple catch
and this time he wants to spank him over his head but the ball just does not come on, the mis-hit rolls back to the bowler
wants to cut it away, hits it hard but straight to the covers
inside edge and the ball goes on the bounce to the keeper, the non-striker rushes to get a single
the bowler's changed, the batsman's changed but the length hasn't, it's short of length and this is spanked away over the mid-wicket fielder for a four
slows it down again and it's pushed to the covers, straight to the fielder
another one pulled away from Saha, was a slower one from PK and it almost did not rise up, he pulls it on the front foot and gets a couple
but this time he gets the bat out at exactly the time he wants it get it to meet the ball, creams it through point for a four!
whoa, beaten by the change down of pace, it was so slow that Saha played his entire stroke and the ball hadn't still come on to the bat, gets a toe and it scoops over the bowler
outside the off stump and he wants to drive it through the covers, does not bounce too much and the shot runs away to a nearby fielder
short of length and he's pulled it over the deep square-leg region for a six, a power-packed shot that!
full-toss outside the off stump and easily punched down the ground for a single
slows down the delivery from round the stumps, drives it down the ground for a single
slows it down from round the stumps and he checks his shot, pushes it to the leg side for a single
on his pads and pushes it to the leg stump for a single
full-toss outside the off stump and it's hit through the off side and it rushes away to the wide long-off area for a couple
single to Saha, tapped down to long-on from round the stumps
slightly drifted on to the pads, pushes it to square-leg for a single
slower one from PK this time, he was early into his shot, which is a defensive prod forward anyway, to the off side, Hussey wanted a single, sent back
man of habit is Praveen Kumar and there is that good length delivery again, outside the off stump and it's pushed into the covers
and the same line and length from PK, on a good length and outside the off, defends it to the short cover region
length ball on the off stump and he pushes it into the covers, not for runs this time
defended on the front foot and it runs away through backward point to third-man, he has to run to his right and they come back for the second, not the best of fielding efforts from Manpreet Gony
swing and miss, Chennai have won by 15 runs in the end...
gone, lbw, Bravo gets his third! very full, yorker length and he was looking to hit it away, gets it on his toe and looks plumb, given too, Satish's gone for a duck
very full yet again and that's crunched down to long-on for only a single
full outside the off and he's hit it through the extra-cover region for a couple of runs to get him to his 50, well played Miller, who's clearly been Punjab's best batsman this season
slower one and that is out too, he was looking to flick it over the leg side, but does not get too much bat there, it goes high in the air and straight to Hussey at long-on

bowled him, first ball on target and he was looking to slap it over the mid-wicket region, gets an edge and the leg-stump are not only on the ground but is also in a couple of pieces, well done Marsh, well played but Chennai might just have edged ahead here
well bowled by Morris, very full and slightly wide, he needed to get some bat on it but does not and it's gone through to the keeper
full on the off stump and that's crunched away to the point region where there are three fielders, goes on the bounce to him and it's fielded well by Hussey
slogged away from the off stump line, was on a good length and he manages to pull it straight to the fielder at mid-wicket region, single
poor, poor delivery, down the leg side and he's flicked it away, over the short fine-leg for a four, this is getting more interesting every passing ball!
round the stumps, fuller on his pads, flicked away to the leg side for a single
shot and Raina has misfielded a straightforward one! good shot, full-toss, punched down the ground and Raina misses it, how on earth!
up and over for a six! it was slower and fuller and the inside-out shot from Miller goes to wide long-off, Ashwin's waiting there but his jump cannot get close to it, six!
full-toss on his pads and scooped away to deep mid-wicket for a single
what an effort from Raina, that's an awesome one, hit hard straight and he runs from long-on, goes for a catch but hes far away, still sticks his right arm to stop it and restricts it to two
top-edge this time and it goes on the bounce to long-off, Hussey comes around to field it
dropped is it? it was hit really hard back to the bowler and he looks to put his hand out almost trying to keep it away from him, hits him and goes to long-on
on his pads and he wants to flick it over deep square-leg, hits his pads and rolls over for a leg-bye
fuller on the legs and he can only hit it down the ground for a single
and four more, short of length and Miller cuts it over the in-field for another four, one bounce and to the boundary!
and that's crunched over the bowler's head for a four, it was hit very hard by Miller and a diving Raina fails to stop it
outside the off stump and a full-toss, tries to crunch it through the covers, goes straight to the fielder, Ashwin who has a shy at the stumps, had that hit, Miller was out
slogged away and straight to deep mid-wicket for a single this time
he tries to slog it away, was on a good length and that's gone on the bounce to long-on for a single
fuller on the off stump and that's crunched through the extra-cover region for a four, what a shot to get them closer to the target!
slower ball and he reads it well, wanted to play it to backward square-leg, gets it squarer
and full again but it's closer to the stumps and can only drive it to wide long-on, gets a couple of runs
swings but misses, good length ball but slows is down considerably and he went for a slog, no bat on it
slammed back for a four, it was on the middle, it was full and he's blasted it back to the bowler, he gets his hand out but it's too late, has already seeped through
outside the off stump and very full, and he was trying to get it through fine third-man again, but misses
short in length, cuts hard but straight to the deep extra-cover fielder and they get a single
shortens the length as the batsman comes down the track, pushed to long-on for a single
whoa, what a shot! that's one of the shots of the game, probably similar to Raina's lofted, inside-out shot early in his innings, Miller does the same and gets a four
full-toss on the off stump and that's crisply played away through the covers for a single
on his pads, not quite full and swept to short fine-leg for a single
goes down the track, it's very slow that from Ashwin which means that he's needed to grab it through to long-on for a single
on the off stump and its punched down to long-off for a single
slower one but tapped to the off side for a single
squeezed away through third-man for a four, Marsh gets to 50! fuller on the off stump and that's well played away with the third-man inside the circle
driven through the covers and gets it into the gap between the two cover fielders for a single
on the pads and he was first looking for an expansive stroke, opens the face of the bat and guides it to short third-man for a single
length ball from over the wicket and he looks to chip it over the in-field to long-on for a single
another one that's right up to the bat and it's pushed down to long-off for a single
fullish from the bowler and he drives down the ground for a single
it's really floated up in the air, slowed down a lot and cut away to the deep point for a single
shorter in length and pushed down to long-off for a single
slightly shorter and flicked away to the leg side for a single now
down the pitch and now Miller's joined in the fun by spanking it over the bowler for a six! that' going to do the run-rate lot of good
bludgeoned away by Marsh and that gets him a four now! what an over that, it was on a length from over the wicket and that's smacked away through wide long-off for a four
and again and for a six! that looked like a mis-hit from Marsh but it's gone all the way over the long-off fence, what a shot!
shot for a six! that's quite full and Marsh opens up well, smacks it over the bowler's head for a maximum!
quicker, flatter, tapped down to long-on for another single
right up to the bat on the leg stump and that's driven to long-on for a single
fuller on the off stump and driven through the off side for a single
and looking to cut this time, misses again, he's not got too many runs off that stroke today
looks to sweep it away but misses, hits the pads
turn, bounce and beaten! Marsh was looking to play him off the back foot, was angling into the bat and it turns away

and now Hussey's gone, caught at long-off! it was on the off stump and he wanted to play it over the long-off fielder, hits it well enough I thought but goes straight to Bravo at long-off who takes the catch to earn himself a dance
leggie from Ashwin and he tries to pull it hard, it was so short that it could have been deposited, not timed well, couple of runs there

goes down the track and slams it over, that's partially caught by Jadeja but he knows he going to cross the fence and he throws the ball back into play, the question is whether he hits the fence before he's thrown it back and replays suggest that yep, it's gone all the way!
short of length from the bowler and that's pulled away to long-on for a single
full ball from Morris, almost a yorker but Hussey somehow manages to gets it between his legs and through the short fine-leg region for a four!
and goes back fully and cuts it again, this time he gets it a tad finer to third-man for a single
gives himself room and plays it through the off side for a single to third-man
fuller on the off stump and drilled down the ground where the long-off fields, single for Marsh
cuts again and for the umpteenth time it goes to the point fielder, he's not yet got them going has Marsh
outside the off from round the stumps and he's able to tap it away to long-off for a single
another one which is very up to the bat and he's only able to tap it back to the right of the bowler for a single
pushed to the off side now, straight to the fielder this time
fuller from the bowler and driven down the ground but not for a single
slows it down from round the stumps and he is looking to work it away to the leg side, gets a leading edge to the off side for a single
on the off stump, he's worked it towards the leg side by walking across there for a single
and now it's over the top of extra-cover for a four! there was Raina there again but it eludes him, was a fuller one and he goes over the top, the fielder did not jump up fully it seems there
outside the off stump, pushed through the covers to the deep fielder there
short of length outside the off stump and tapped to the off side
slower ball from Mohit and it's given a hard shot, goes over the top and with the mid-off up inside the circle, it's easily beaten him to the fence
shorter in length and opens the face of the bat, runs it through to third-man for a single
ooh, close to getting out there, it was outside the off and he tries to drive it through the covers, misses the outside edge, misses the stumps and goes to Dhoni
wants to pull it away but it quite slow and the shot's played quite early by the captain, Hussey, beats him and it rolls over to the other captain, Dhoni.
shorter and slower and rolls his wrist over that one, single to the square-leg area
over the top of mid-on for a four! good shot by Marsh, on a good length and he's not really it off the middle, still easily evades the fielder
slower one there and he opens the face of the bat and runs it down to third-man for a single
on a length and on middle stump, pushes it to short cover where it just falls short of Raina
on his pads and slower from round the stumps, nurdles it around the corner for a single
and now he's gone, caught at extra-cover! was looking to go over the top, inside-out, but hits it straight to the fielder there, Raina takes a simple catch and they have lost their second
short of length, slower one and pulled away to the deep square-leg region for a four, the ball did not bounce too much and he had to adjust the stroke, does it well!
gives himself some room, was looking to flay it away but gets it to the fielder, Raina gets a good bounce and throws at the non-striker's end where Marsh's far away from the crease, misses
closer to the bat, fuller too and tapped to the mid-on fielder for a single
shot! slower ball but fuller up to the bat and driven through wide mid-off for a four, that's his second one for the evening
short of length outside the off stump and he wants to play one of those favourite cuts of his, the ball just does not come on to him

on his pads, quicker too and he was looking to run it away to fine-leg, the keeper was up to the stumps that time in order to prevent him from going down the pitch, hits his pads and falls close to Dhoni
slower from the bowler, on a good length and defended back to the bowler
on his pads, was looking to flick it away, hits it on his pads and rolls it over to the leg side
was looking to pull it again and it keeps a tad low, was quick too and it hits his pad, rolls over to the off side
short of length from Morkel from round the wicket, he was trying to pull it but the ball did not come on too well and he just taps it away to the leg side for a single
outside the off stump and on a length, he opens the face of the bat and gets it down to third-man for a single
wants to drive it through the point region this time but hits it straight to the fielder and not for runs
short of length and Marsh has absolutely cracked it through mid-wicket for a four, there was a fielder at deep square-leg but he hits it in front of square there
slower one there and on the length, opens the face of the bat and runs it down to third-man for a single
length ball on the off stump line, he pats it to the off side and there's a fielder within the circle to stop any single there
round the stumps and short of length too, punched down to mid-on for a quick single
shot, dropped! short of length and he cracks it to the deep mid-wicket, hit crisply as well and straight to Bravo but he's dropped a sitter!
on his pads and flicked away to square-leg, straight to the fielder, Ashwin and he makes a meal of it, misfields an easy one and they cross over for a single
slower one on his pads and flicked away to the leg side for a single, deep square-leg comes in to field
fullish in length this time, and Marsh wants to drive it through, not able to thread it though, gets it to the right of Raina who dives at short cover and fields
and this one jags back into the batsman, carefully defends it to the off side
round the stumps and outside the off, enough room to drive it through but decides to punch it to the off, to the fielder though
pulled away, was shorter in the length and does well to hit it to deep square-leg for a single

bowled him, poor slog and it misses the bat, hits the stumps and they have lost one! he was looking to hit across the line, was on the length and he thought it was in the slot to play that stroke, but does not get it on his bat, bowled
bouncer and a quick one at that, he was first looking to pull it away but decides against it in the end
short of length and defended off the back foot, that was bowled from over the wicket after starting off from round
fuller on the leg stump, driven to Hussey at mid-on who's is the lone man on the field with an orange cap on his head
crunch, that's hit hard and in the gap for a four! outside the off stump and he was giving himself some room, creates some width and punishes that one
on the middle stump and short of length, flicks it away to short fine-leg and fielded well by Morkel, has a shy at the striker's end, does not hit or could have been close
on his pads and gently crunched it through the leg side for a couple of runs
and another one that's short of good length, cramping him for room, was looking to pull it away but it's too quick for him, gets some pad on it and pops up over Dhoni
outside the off stump and punched through extra-cover for a four! that was a short of a length ball too and well played, packs a lot of punch there
down the track and tapped to the mid-on region for a single
on the pads but not too quick this time, he was trying to work it towards the leg-side, bit of a leading edge
on the off stump and defended to the off side by the batsman
